lines: Donon jahaan teri mohabbat mein haar ke
couplets.en: I lost both worlds for love of you.

lines: Woh ja raha hai koi shab-e-gham guzaar ke
couplets.en: Someone is leaving after a night of sorrow.

lines: Viraan hai maikada, khum-o-saaghar udaas hain
couplets.en: The tavern is empty, and the wine jar and goblet look forlorn.

lines: Tum kya gaye ki rooth gaye din bahaar ke
couplets.en: When you left, even the days of spring turned away.

lines: Tum kya gaye ki rooth gaye din bahaar ke
couplets.en: When you left, even the days of spring turned away.

lines: Ik fursat-e-gunaah mili, woh bhi chaar din
couplets.en: I was granted a little time to sin, a mere four days.

lines: Ik fursat-e-gunaah mili, woh bhi chaar din
couplets.en: I was granted a little time to sin, a mere four days.

lines: Dekhe hain humne hausle parvardigaar ke
couplets.en: So this is how far the Lord would dare to go.

lines: Duniya ne teri yaad se begaana kar diya
couplets.en: The world has made me a stranger to the memory of you.

lines: Duniya ne teri yaad se begaana kar diya
couplets.en: The world has made me a stranger to the memory of you.

lines: Tujh se bhi dil-fareb hain gham rozgaar ke
couplets.en: Even you are less beguiling than the sorrows of making a living.
